title: Composer dependency pinned to a development branch
description: composer.json declares a `dev-…` constraint, which follows a VCS branch. The branch moves, so a package install on any day can differ from the one reviewed, and the install pulls from the VCS rather than Packagist.
limitation: It matches a `dev-…` constraint, which follows a VCS branch in the parsed composer.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
